# Vatayan Labs

> Independent, data-driven research on Indian banking, payments, mutual funds and capital markets, by Manu Vatayan Jha. Every number is sourced from primary regulatory data (RBI, NPCI, SEBI, AMFI) and company filings. "Vatayan" is Sanskrit for window — a window into how India moves money.

## Live dashboards (interactive, primary data)

- [RBI Annual Report 2025-26 Dashboard](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/rbi-annual-report-2025-26/): India credit growth, payments, money supply and financial inclusion from the RBI Annual Report.
- [India Payments Intelligence](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/india-payments/): UPI QR, credit card, debit card and ATM trends from RBI monthly returns, March 2024 to June 2026 — including the digital-vs-cash crossover and the four consecutive months digital has held the majority.
- [Bank vs Bank — Payments Comparison](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/india-payments/compare/): Head-to-head comparison of any two Indian banks across 25 RBI payment metrics, plus peer-group league tables for PSUs, private banks, small finance banks, payments banks and foreign banks.
- [India Banking Scorecard](https://vatayanlabs.com/dashboards/indian-banks/): Quarterly reported PAT, Gross NPA and Net NPA for 25 Indian banks and NBFCs, Q2FY25-Q1FY27, plus market cap, P/E, P/BV, RoE and RoA snapshots.

## Sector studies (long-form research)

- [Gold](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/gold/): India's Rs 16.8 lakh crore gold loan story — 3-part series.
- [Defence](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/defence/): "Read the Defence" — 7-part series on India's defence decade, HAL, BEL and the value chain.
- [Microfinance](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/microfinance/): The microfinance stress cycle and the CGSMFI-2.0 credit guarantee.
- [Mutual Funds](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/mutual-funds/): The SIP illusion, momentum funds, the 77% concentration problem in Indian equity portfolios, and India's first REIT index fund.
- [Semiconductors](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/semiconductors/): Five-part business study of Lumentum ($LITE) — photonics, the NVIDIA relationship, valuation and the India angle.
- [Capital Markets](https://vatayanlabs.com/sectors/capital-markets/): 4-part series on India's market infrastructure — depositories (CDSL/NSDL), RTAs and global peers.
